units.text: According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, iPhone Duo buyers who purchase their device at an Apple Store in the US will be treated to a nice little surprise when they turn it on for the first time. Here are the details.
Cool surprise in store for in-store buyers
When Apple launches the iPhone Duo on October 23, some customers who purchase the device at an Apple Store in the US will be able to have its initial setup screen personalized with their name.

According to Gurman, “Apple retail stores will have a system to customize the boot of the device,” allowing the iPhone Duo to display a greeting containing their name when it turns on for the first time. Gurman says the feature will be exclusive to the iPhone Duo, and support both English and Spanish.

Fun little touch for the iPhone Duo launch: Apple retail stores will have a system to customize the boot of the device with the buyer's name so it says "Hello, Mark" (for example) when it turns on for the first time. (US only, Duo only, English and Spanish).
— Mark Gurman (@markgurman) October 9, 2026
It is not clear how Apple will implement the feature, or whether it will rely on Presto, the system Apple Stores already use to wirelessly update iPhones without removing them from their boxes.
First reported by Gurman in 2023, Presto allows Apple retail employees to turn on an iPhone, install software updates, and turn it off again, all while the device remains sealed in its packaging.
Back to the iPhone Duo, it will be available to pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with deliveries and in-store availability beginning October 23.
Apple recently announced that customers will be able to get ready for iPhone Duo pre-orders beginning October 12, and you can read more about that here.
Are you planning to buy an iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.

Apple reportedly plans to unveil an all-new smart home hub during its "Welcome home" launch on Tuesday, October 13 . Will the device be named HomeView, and will its all-new operating system be named homeOS? We shall soon find out. Apple has a history of using shell companies to secretly file trademarks related to unannounced hardware and software. For example, prior to the Apple Vision Pro launching in 2023, a shell company that was ultimately connected to Apple filed a trademark for " visionOS ," which ended up being the name of the Vision Pro's operating system. However, Apple was also behind a trademark for an "xrOS" name that it ultimately abandoned in favor of visionOS, so trademark filings do not always correspond with Apple's final branding decisions. "HomePad" is another speculative name for Apple's home hub, given that the device is expected to be somewhat of a HomePod-iPad hybrid. Perhaps the device will have a straightforward "Apple Home" name? That name could be confusing given there is also an Apple Home app, but this is a company that has an Apple TV 4K device, an Apple TV app, and an Apple TV streaming service, so it is certainly possible. Or maybe "HomePod Pro" instead? Share your guesses in the comments section. units.text: Apple has reportedly cut orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max due to “soft demand.” A new report from Nikkei Asia says Apple has told select suppliers to cut component production for the devices, as price increases allegedly “dampened consumer demand.”
Price hikes reportedly dampen iPhone 18 Pro demand

The report cites “multiple familiar with the matter,” and claims Apple has “turned more conservative on shipments since early September. Two of those sources claim that component orders for October have been cut by “at least 15%” compared to what Apple originally requested.

“In October alone, we are seeing orders from Apple reducing by 15% to 20% for both the premium models; we don’t know how things would develop from here,” said one of the executive-level sources. The order cuts will affect production volumes for some, but not all, suppliers in October due to differing production lead times, and it is not immediately clear whether Apple will make further adjustments from November onward.

Another anonymous supply chain manager told Nikkei Asia that demand is “not as strong as previous years when all the new models are introduced all together.” This, of course, refers to Apple not releasing the base iPhone 18 until next spring. Still, the suppliers say that this alone doesn’t account for the lower demand.

One source added that they expect a “similar fate for the iPhone Duo” after it’s released, referring to potential production cuts.

Apple increased prices for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max by $100 compared to their predecessors. While hampering demand, this also means that the impact of that lower demand won’t “immediately translate to lower revenue for Apple,” the report explains.
Apple will report its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings on Monday, November 6. This will provide a look at the first several weeks of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max demand.

units.text: A post on X from “pdfu,” who has previously posted leaks and renders of suspected Apple features and LG smart home gear, shows new details of rumored Apple Home accessories from LG. According to the new leak, they could include an NFC-based “Proximity Control” feature that pops up a hint for a device’s controls in the iPhone’s Dynamic Island, simply by putting the phone close to it. The post also says it’s executed using the Matter protocol, but appears to be an Apple Home-specific feature, and follows yesterday’s leak showing a “tap to setup without power” pairing feature and other upcoming devices.

units.text: 一名长期发布苹果功能线索的爆料者称，苹果正为传闻中的LG智能家居配件开发名为“Proximity Control”的近距离控制功能。用户用iPhone轻触或靠近配件后，灵动岛可能会显示设备控制提示，点击“打开控制”即可进入相应面板；如果靠近的是摄像头或智能门铃，界面据称可直接打开摄像画面。它并非轻触后就立即开灯、开锁或改变温度，而是让用户更快打开对应设备的控制界面。
据爆料者描述，该功能可能依靠NFC标签识别配件，并通过Matter数据中的设备标识让iOS判断用户接近了哪一台设备；配件还会广播蓝牙低功耗信号，以支持苹果的近距离控制功能。没有灵动岛的iPhone以及iPad据称会改以约30秒的通知显示提示，用户也可在“家庭”App中关闭该功能。具体设置方式和交互尚未最终确定。
此前彭博报道称，苹果与LG合作开发一系列智能家居产品，传闻中的设备包括视频门铃、智能温控器、门锁、室内外摄像头和泛光灯摄像头，部分产品预计支持Matter和Thread。另一项此前泄露的功能是通过NFC轻触配件进行配对，甚至可在设备未通电时完成设置。苹果尚未确认这些产品或功能确实存在，相关细节目前主要来自FCC文件、iOS测试版代码线索及社交媒体爆料。
爆料者称，“靠近控制”的代码最早已出现在iOS 27.0，并在iOS 27.2测试版中出现相关选项；他也提醒，该功能仍在开发过程中，正式版本可能调整。苹果计划于10月13日举行以智能家居为主题的“Welcome Home”活动，外界预计公司可能介绍新的家庭中枢设备，但LG配件是否会在活动上亮相，目前没有官方确认。

但数据一出来，剧情直接反转：国内开售三周，iPhone18 Pro系列激活量已经突破300万台，稳居高端手机销量前排，甚至拿下了国内单周销量榜榜首。
按照数码博主放出的统计数据，国庆所在的W40这一周，单单iPhone18 Pro Max单周激活量就突破76万台，Pro系列两款机型合计单周激活112万台。
开售前三周累计激活289万，最新统计实时数据已经跨过300万大关。在万元价位的高端旗舰赛道，这个成绩放在当下手机市场，绝对算得上亮眼，远超不少同价位国产旗舰。
不过热搜里提到的砍单传闻，也并不是凭空捏造。多家媒体援引知情人士消息，存储芯片成本大涨，迫使苹果上调新机售价，一定程度上压制了部分消费需求，苹果已经通知部分供应商，削减iPhone18 Pro以及Pro Max的零部件产能。
有供应链高管透露，10月这两款机型的零部件订单相比最初计划，至少下调15%，部分渠道降幅甚至达到15%-20%。
很多网友看到 “砍单” 两个字，直接等同于产品卖崩。但这里有个很容易被忽略的关键点：今年苹果调整了发布节奏，优先推出三款高端机型，标准版iPhone18、iPhone Air推迟到明年春季才登场。
有业内人士分析，这次订单缩减，不一定单纯代表销量崩盘，也可能是苹果提前预判市场，调整备货节奏，避免库存积压。
另外，18系列内部热度分化特别明显。Pro Max更受消费者青睐，不少用户宁愿多花钱一步到位，而普通版iPhone18 Pro需求偏弱，部分渠道甚至出现破发，冷热差距巨大。
简单来说，不是整个系列全面卖不动，而是两款机型市场反馈两极分化，大家更愿意加预算上高配版本。
涨价是绕不开的话题。存储芯片成本上涨，iPhone18 Pro系列售价上调，劝退了一部分预算有限的用户，这也是供应链下调订单的核心原因之一。
但高端换机群体对价格敏感度更低，加上2nm芯片、影像升级等硬件更新，依然吸引大量果粉换新，300万台的激活数据就是最直观的证明。
所以，“卖不动” 其实是个片面的结论。放在大环境里看，iPhone18 Pro系列高端大盘依旧强劲，只是涨价带来需求分化，苹果顺势调整供应链备货，才有了砍单消息。
一边是供应链订单下调，一边是激活量持续走高，这种看似矛盾的现象，就是当下高端手机市场最真实的写照。
当然，热度归热度，万元起步的定价，门槛摆在那里。究竟是短期首发红利，还是能够长期稳住销量，后续市场的表现，我们继续蹲一波。那么，你今年买了苹果Phone18 Pro吗？

evidence.discovery_lead: Smart home accessories that Apple reportedly helped LG develop could offer iPhone proximity controls and a way to begin setup before the devices have power, according to findings shared by the leaker known as " pdfu ." The findings concern the upcoming LG-branded accessory range that Bloomberg revealed earlier this week . The lineup reportedly includes a thermostat, temperature sensor, deadbolt lock, wired video doorbell, and several security cameras. Apple apparently co-developed the accessories. One of the features, called "Proximity Control," will surface a shortcut when an iPhone is tapped against or brought close to an accessory. Pdfu says the Dynamic Island will present an "Open Controls" option for products such as thermostats. Cameras and doorbells will instead display a camera viewer. The interaction will also apparently work on iPads and iPhones without a ‌Dynamic Island‌, using a notification that remains visible for 30 seconds. A setting in the Home app will let users switch proximity controls off after configuring the accessory. MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris identified the Dynamic Island references earlier this week. Pdfu says the underlying feature has appeared in code since iOS 27.0, with its settings changing during development. Earlier versions included an option to open controls automatically, but the enabled setting in iOS 27.2 currently asks users to open them through a prompt. According to the leaker, the accessories will use an identifier stored on an NFC tag alongside a Bluetooth Low Energy broadcast to support recognition and proximity interactions. Tapping a device for the first time will also produce ‌Dynamic Island‌ feedback as setup begins. Apple's "second-party" LG accessories will debut another Home feature: Proximity Control. As with HomePod, tapping or bringing iPhone near the accessory shows a hint in the Dynamic Island. An "Open Controls" button opens the accessory's controls. Cameras and doorbells show a camera viewer. An iPhone without a Dynamic Island or an iPad will show a 30-second notification instead. You can disable this behavior in the Home app after setup. You'll also see feedback in the Dynamic Island as iPhone launches setup when you first tap the accessory to pair it. Behind the scenes, the accessory writes an "apple-deviceid" in the Matter payload stored on its NFC tag that helps iOS identify it when tapped. It also broadcasts a Bluetooth Low Energy advert for Apple Proximity Control. The feature appears in code since iOS 27.0. In earlier versions, Apple showed three presentation options instead of the on/off toggle in iOS 27.2: • Never: Suppresses proximity controls.​ • Ask to Launch: ​Shows Dynamic Island hint or notification, which deep links the control card. • Launch Automatically: Shows control card.​ In the current implementation, the enabled state is equivalent to Ask to Launch. Home's helper text reads: "Show controls when you bring your iPhone near your [accessory]." The feature is still in active development across beta releases, so the final behavior may change. The Dynamic Island proximity control code in iOS 27.2 was first reported by @aaronp613 and @MacRumors. — pdfu (@itspdfu) October 9, 2026 The second feature, described in a separate post , will allow pairing to start while an accessory is unpowered. An iPhone will transfer its pairing identity and network credentials into the accessory's secure element using near-field communication (NFC). When the device receives power, it will connect to Wi-Fi or Thread, allowing a home hub to finish Matter setup. Pdfu says that this setup method will be exclusive to HomeKit . LG replaces the secure element's Matter NFC applet with a ‌HomeKit‌ applet, even though iOS 27 also supports standard Matter NFC. Conventional Matter pairing will remain available once the accessories are powered on. LG home accessories are set to debut with HomeKit-exclusive "tap to set up without power" feature, according to iOS 27 code and device firmware. When you tap your iPhone on the accessory, HomeKit pairing happens over NFC. Your iPhone's pairing identity and network credentials are stored in the accessory's NFC secure element. Once powered on, the accessory joins your Wi‑Fi or Thread network, and your home hub completes the Matter setup. • Apple's HomeKit-over-NFC implementation is separate from Matter NFC Commissioning. • Firmware for the LG lock and thermostat identifies an NXP SE051H Secure Element. • While iOS 27 supports standard Matter NFC commissioning, LG's firmware replaces NXP's Matter NFC applet in the secure element with a HomeKit applet. This suggests that NFC provisioning will be a HomeKit exclusive. You can still pair the accessories over Matter once they're powered on. An exclusive new HomeKit feature

Earlier this week, Aaron Perris discovered code references to a new feature where “nearby smart home accessories could show controls in the Dynamic Island.” Now, @itspdfu has found even more details about how this feature will work.
In a new social media post today, pdfu says Apple’s “second-party” home accessories co-developed with LG will support this new “Proximity Control” feature.

When you tap or bring your iPhone near one of LG’s accessories, a notification will pop out of the Dynamic Island. The notification will show an “Open Controls” button for accessories like thermostats. For cameras and doorbells, you’ll see a “camera viewer.”
The account explains:
You’ll also see feedback in the Dynamic Island as iPhone launches setup when you first tap the accessory to pair it.

Behind the scenes, the accessory writes an “apple-deviceid” in the Matter payload stored on its NFC tag that helps iOS identify it when tapped. It also broadcasts a Bluetooth Low Energy advert for Apple Proximity Control.

You’ll seemingly have the option to turn this feature off in the Home app. As always, features referenced in Apple’s code might not ship, or they could work materially differently when they do launch.

units.text: 市场研究机构IDC最新发布的初步数据显示，尽管苹果Mac电脑在2026年第三季度的出货量同比出现下滑，但由于全球个人电脑市场整体萎缩幅度更大，苹果反而进一步提升了自身市场份额。
数据显示，苹果在2026年7月至9月期间共出货约590万台Mac电脑，相比2025年同期的670万台下降11.3%。不过，苹果同期市场份额从上年第三季度的8.5%提升至9.5%，继续位列全球PC厂商第四名。
从整个行业来看，全球PC市场第三季度出货量降至6270万台，较去年同期的7850万台大幅减少20.1%。相比之下，今年第二季度的同比跌幅为3.8%。值得注意的是，第三季度通常属于PC行业相对繁忙的销售季，但本季度出货量仍较第二季度低9.1%，反映出市场需求明显走弱。
在厂商排名方面，联想以1490万台出货量继续保持全球第一；惠普以1030万台位居第二；戴尔则以760万台排名第三。这三家公司出货量分别同比下降22.6%、30.9%和25%。排名第五的华硕出货量为550万台，同比下滑8.6%，成为全球前五大PC厂商中唯一一家跌幅低于苹果的企业。
IDC分析认为，本季度市场疲软与厂商和渠道商此前提前备货有关。由于担心存储芯片价格上涨，不少企业选择提早采购库存，导致原本应在下半年产生的订单被提前消化。现阶段渠道中仍保留着较多库存，因此第三季度对于新增设备订单的需求明显减弱。
与此同时，IDC还指出，零部件供应短缺以及成本上升同样对市场造成压力。研究机构认为，人工智能数据中心建设快速扩张正在推高相关零组件需求，并进一步影响供应链成本。苹果已于今年6月上调部分产品售价，而前首席执行官Tim Cook在公司7月财报电话会议上也曾提到，存储器成本正出现大幅上涨。

新机需求低于预期，苹果下调零部件订单
苹果近期开始调整iPhone 18 Pro系列的供应链订单，要求部分供应商减少相关零部件生产。此次削减主要涉及9月刚刚推出的iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max两款高端机型。
供应链消息显示，苹果自9月初以来逐步下调出货预期，并将10月相关零部件订单量削减15%至20%。
新机需求疲软与生产成本上升密切相关。随着存储芯片和其他电子零部件价格持续上涨，苹果被迫提高新款iPhone售价，而终端价格上涨进一步削弱了消费者的购买需求。
产品发布节奏调整，也可能影响零部件采购规模
除市场需求因素外，苹果今年调整iPhone产品发布计划，也可能是零部件订单减少的原因之一。按照新的发布节奏，苹果今年9月率先推出高端机型，包括iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max及iPhone Duo，而标准版iPhone 18和升级版iPhone Air则计划于2027年初上市。
这一策略改变了苹果以往集中推出新款iPhone的产品节奏，也使不同机型的生产与零部件采购时间出现分化。
值得注意的是，标准版iPhone在去年的iPhone 17系列中受到更多消费者青睐。随着iPhone 18标准版推迟至2027年初上市，部分潜在购买需求可能随之延后，并在新机发布后转化为销售增长。因此，高端机型零部件订单减少，既反映出当前市场需求低于预期，也可能与苹果调整产品组合和上市时间有关。
AI产业争夺存储芯片产能，消费电子成本压力或延续至2027年
苹果此次供应链调整也反映出全球消费电子行业面临的成本压力。随着人工智能产业快速扩张，AI服务器及相关基础设施对存储芯片和其他电子元器件的需求大幅增加，挤压了消费电子产品可获得的供应量，推动零部件价格上涨。
存储芯片制造商美光近期的表态显示，全球存储芯片供应紧张的局面可能持续至2027年较晚时候。
这意味着，智能手机等消费电子制造商可能在未来较长一段时间内持续面临零部件采购成本上升的压力。企业若通过提高终端售价转嫁成本，可能进一步抑制消费者需求；若自行承担部分成本上涨，则可能压缩产品利润率。
对苹果而言，接下来的关键在于高端iPhone需求能否回升，以及计划于2027年初推出的标准版iPhone 18和升级版iPhone Air能否带动新一轮销售增长。

公开资料将申请人列为Home Services LLC，注册地址位于特拉华州威尔明顿，但没有文件证明该公司由苹果持有或代表苹果申请，因此苹果与该商标的关系仍属推测。

Apple hasn’t confirmed ‘Welcome home’ keynote, but Mark Gurman says an ‘online video presentation’ is coming

Apple has been shaking up its typical product launch approaches this year. The MacBook Neo was the first example when it debuted in March with an in-person press “experience” following multiple days of press releases launching other products.
Now Apple’s ‘Welcome home’ launch on October 13 looks set to similarly tread new ground.
Unlike a traditional event, Apple hasn’t yet added ‘Welcome home’ to its Apple Events webpage. And there’s no evidence of a livestream on YouTube or the Apple TV app.
These things could all change in the coming days ahead of the launch. However, currently they indicate there won’t be a keynote video on October 13.
However, Mark Gurman at Bloomberg says a video presentation is coming. In his report about another Apple launch coming October 27, Gurman writes:
Like its smart home event on Oct. 13, the next launch will include an online video presentation and in-person component for the press
So according to Gurman, who accurately reported the October 13 date and its focus on Home products, Apple will have “an online video presentation” next week.
Press are attending a NYC “Apple Experience” that starts at 9:00 a.m. ET. So if there is an announcement video, we’ll likely see it debut online then—much earlier than the typical keynote time.
We’re expecting at least three new products on Tuesday, which you can read about here.
Do you expect Apple to have a keynote video for ‘Welcome home’? Let us know in the comments.
